title: The ideal routine.
author: Get shit On
desc:
Train in the intended HIT way

Remember to always take atleast 3 days of rest between the workouts

ex.note: Do the incline press in a superset fashion, use a closer grip not a wide grip.
Do a close grip palms up pulldown.
If you expirience back pain during deadlifts you may Substitute this exercise
Do the leg press in a superset fashion with   The legextention

Do the dips in a superset fashion with your tricep pushdown. 
Use a str8 bar or a v bar not a rope
Use 30lbs more than last time, hold it in the contracted Position for 15-20 seconds do a smith squat or regular squat afterwards
